SELECT
    toYear(s.DateKey) AS year,
    toMonth(s.DateKey) AS month,
    sum(s.SalesQuantity) AS units_sold,
    sum(s.SalesAmount) AS gross_sales,
    sum(s.ReturnAmount) AS returns_amount,
    sum(s.DiscountAmount) AS discount_amount,
    sum(s.SalesAmount - s.ReturnAmount - s.DiscountAmount) AS net_sales,
    sum(s.SalesAmount - s.ReturnAmount - s.DiscountAmount - s.TotalCost) AS gross_profit,
    round(
        sum(s.SalesAmount - s.ReturnAmount - s.DiscountAmount - s.TotalCost)
        / nullIf(sum(s.SalesAmount - s.ReturnAmount - s.DiscountAmount), 0),
        4
    ) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM
(
    SELECT
        DateKey,
        ProductKey,
        SalesQuantity,
        SalesAmount,
        ReturnAmount,
        DiscountAmount,
        TotalCost
    FROM retail.FactSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        DateKey,
        ProductKey,
        SalesQuantity,
        SalesAmount,
        ReturnAmount,
        DiscountAmount,
        TotalCost
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS s
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE pc.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras'
GROUP BY
    year,
    month
ORDER BY
    year,
    month
